# Lifecycle and assignment

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 3 · Architecture

Parent page: [Device Requests](domain-device-requests.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:48ef5edd1066de56 -->
The core of the domain: public submission, validation, volunteer assignment and status progression up to completion or closure as not feasible. It also holds the concepts that make the lifecycle work, such as the internal status model, the public status, the separation of private data and the request number. Read it first when you need to understand how a request travels from a citizen to a volunteer.
